svg.title: Figure 5-3. Where each timing requirement stands (WP-S-04 §5)
svg.desc: 19 timing requirements of WP-S-04 §5. RX loss: met by design in the reference build, not verified; ≤ 0.2 s by design; 0x262 marginal at ≈ 0.21 s. RX stuck/inserted: not met; rate, frozen-content and cross-checks not built. SoC heartbeat loss: partly, or just over the budget; revoke by design ≤ 0.31 s; SILENT still 4–5 s. SoC heartbeat loss → warning: met by design in the reference build, not verified; siren ≤ 0.56 s when authority was granted. Host/panda mismatch: met by design in the reference build, not verified; revoked ≤ 0.31 s (was 2–3 s). SoC command stall: partly, or just over the budget; ≤ 0.06 s against 0.05 s: one task period over. MCU hang: met by design in the reference build, not verified; ≈ 90 ms watchdog, if the clock tolerance holds. Relay stuck released: not met; no relay read-back. Brake / cancel: met (code-derived, envelope side); 25–30 ms; EPS and PCM response to verify. Steering override: not met; no driver-torque monitor in the envelope. Stale SoC inputs: not met; 3–3.5 s of actuation on a failed input. Diagnostic masking: not met; up to 5 s blind while the big model loads. Cruise mismatch: not met; 6 s, no reaction. sendcan age: not met; 1 s against 20 ms. Take-over request: no derived time yet; alerts immediate; latency not measured. Cruise active with main off: met by design in the reference build, not verified; refused at once; revoked after 150 ms. SoC TX rate above budget: met by design in the reference build, not verified; revoked ≤ 0.1 s after the first rejected frame. EPS fault: met by design in the reference build, not verified; torque refused at once; siren ≤ 0.96 s. Full SoC stall → warning: met by design in the reference build, not verified; siren ≤ 0.31 s after the last command frame.

Nothing in this figure is measured: “met” is derived from the code, “by design” is implemented in the reference build and simulated at most. The measurements are §6 (M-01…M-12).

g.text: Terms: CI continuous integration: the checks that run on every pull request · EPS electric power steering · LKA lane keeping assist · M-nn timing measurement of the plan in WP-S-04 §6 · MCU microcontroller: the

panda safety processor (STM32H7) · PCM powertrain control module (engine and drive) · RX receive · SG-nn safety goal (HARA §6) · SILENT the panda's safety mode that sends nothing · SoC system on chip: the comma

device's main processor, running openpilot (QM) · T-nn code-derived detection or reaction time (WP-S-04 §4); in WP-M-01 and WP-S-06, a tailoring decision T-01…T-08 (WP-M-01 §5) · TSR-nn technical safety requirement
